summary.title: Summary
summary.text: Platform Engineer with 4 years of experience in cloud-native infrastructure and DevOps practices. Currently working as Infrastructure Specialist responsible for migrating and operating critical DevOps toolchains on Kubernetes in OVH Cloud. Focus areas: Infrastructure as Code, GitOps workflows, and scalable database solutions across multiple clusters. Hands-on mentality with focus on automation and pragmatic solutions. Passion for cloud-native technologies and open-source ecosystems.

jobs.title: Infrastructure Specialist
responsibilities: Migration and operation of critical DevOps toolchain from on-premises to Kubernetes in OVH Cloud with minimal downtime for CI/CD, issue tracking, and collaboration tools

Design and rollout of highly available PostgreSQL infrastructure with CloudNativePG across 20 Kubernetes clusters with automated backup, point-in-time recovery, and cluster-wide backup strategy via Velero and S3 storage

Implementation and management of cluster-wide service mesh with Istio for advanced traffic management, security, and observability using VirtualServices, Gateways, PeerAuthentication, and DestinationRules
Standardization of multi-cluster deployments through ArgoCD ApplicationSets and App-of-Apps pattern for improved maintainability and scalability across 20 clusters
Maintenance and operation of central monitoring and observability stack with Prometheus, Grafana, Elasticsearch, Kibana, and Kiali for entire infrastructure
Implementation of security best practices through Sealed Secrets, Kyverno policies, and management of central container registry for enterprise-wide image and package management

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
responsibilities: Development and operation of CI/CD pipelines for automating build, test, and deployment processes for development teams
Automation of cloud infrastructure provisioning with Terraform on AWS for consistent, versioned, and reproducible environments
Management and automation of lifecycle management for over 200 Linux servers using Ansible for updates, upgrades, and configuration changes
Setup and management of Proxmox virtualization platform for server and container workloads to optimize resource utilization
Implementation and operation of enterprise-wide monitoring system with Zabbix for all Linux systems for proactive error identification
